questions.q: Using the case-study business's name, facts and figures in your answer shows which skill?
questions.why: AO2 Application = using the context and data of the case.

questions.q: Which command word requires you to make a decision and support it?
questions.why: Justify needs a judgement with reasons why it is better than the alternatives (evaluation).

questions.q: For top marks in a 12-mark 'Recommend… justify your answer' question you must:
options: list the advantages of every option
decide and explain why your choice beats the other options
conclude that all options have merits
questions.why: Evaluation means a clear, reasoned decision that compares options; sitting on the fence limits marks.

questions.q: Develop this point into analysis: "Training will improve workers' skills."
questions.model: …so workers make fewer mistakes, which reduces waste and lowers costs, so the business's profit increases.
points: chain of consequences using 'so / therefore / which leads to'
ends with an effect on the business (costs, sales, profit, quality)
